Needed: A coffee table or a box with room for the screen and the controls for Gaming coffee table shell
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "cracked glass", "upright cabinet", "bartop arcade", "table top only"], "pattern": "(gaming|arcade).{0,20}(coffee|cocktail).{0,20}(table|cabinet|shell)", "phrasings": [{"text": "gaming coffee table", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=gaming+coffee+table", "why": "Finds generic gaming furniture listings that do not use arcade terms."}, {"text": "arcade coffee table", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=arcade+coffee+table", "why": "Finds sellers describing an arcade table in coffee table words."}, {"text": "cocktail arcade cabinet", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=cocktail+arcade+cabinet", "why": "Finds the common cocktail name for this screen-in-table style that coffee misses."}, {"text": "cocktail table arcade machine", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=cocktail+table+arcade+machine", "why": "Finds complete tables sold as machines that could supply the shell and controls space."}, {"text": "arcade table shell empty", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=arcade+table+shell+empty", "why": "Finds empty box shells for building, missing by complete machine phrasings."}]}
